dedupe_keys.name: xerogel fluoride and bromide adsorption equilibrium measurements

description: This deposit contains laboratory characterization and adsorption-equilibrium data for resorcinol-formaldehyde xerogels modified with melamine. The Universidad Autonoma de San Luis Potosi team evaluates removal of fluoride and bromide from water and fits Langmuir, Freundlich and Radke-Prausnitz isotherms. Experiments vary melamine ratios and carbonization temperature; equilibrium tests use 0.02 grams of adsorbent in fifty millilitres of solution, with initial ion concentrations from ten to one hundred milligrams per litre. Mendeley version 2 lists eleven Excel workbooks free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is controlled material testing in Mexico, with no stated field-monitoring period. Batch equilibrium results do not establish full-scale filter kinetics, operating lifetime or mixed-contaminant performance. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating adsorption components or comparing treatment-material assumptions. model-epanet is a related water-network tool, requiring a separate treatment-process representation. No workbook, isotherm fitting routine or treatment simulation was executed.
